title: PresenceUserConfigProfile - Data API
description: Represents a configuration that determines the settings that are assigned to presence users who are assigned to a specific profile. User-level configurations override profile-level configurations. This object is available in API version 32.0 and later.

PresenceUserConfigId.description: If an individual user is also assigned a presence configuration through the PresenceUserConfigProfile, this configuration will override that.

ProfileId.description: The ID of the profile that’s associated with this presence configuration. A profile can be associated with only one presence configuration.

special_access_rules:
To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled. As of Spring ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.
